universe_note:
Chain-level campaign-v1 screen (identity_schema campaign-v1, scenario_id null), first run for this chain. Universe built per LINK across all 13 links, worked in priority order: the one money-corner link first, then the three CHOKE_POINT links, then the rest by chain position. The mapping (data/mappings/glp1-fill-finish.json, 14 listings, 16 placements) carries no fresh-context census audit at all (audit: null, status ACTIVE, never run), so every row this run must rest on Ron's 2026-09-01 PLACEMENT-scope rule: audit_scope "PLACEMENT" declared on the row, admitted only when the consumed placement's role evidence is entirely VERIFIED.

Two independent admissibility bars apply to every one of the mapping's 14 issuers, and this run found they do not currently overlap on a single one. Bar one, evidence tier: 5 of the 16 placements carry only VERIFIED evidence (CORNING/pharma-glass-tubing citing a Corning-Pfizer supply-agreement press release, STEVANATO-GROUP/primary-containment-converters and ATS-CORPORATION/device-assembly-automation and DR-REDDYS-LABORATORIES/generic-and-biosimilar-glp1-entrants each citing a Form 6-K exhibit, NOVO-NORDISK/glp1-demand-anchor citing a Form 6-K annual-report exhibit); the other 11 placements (WEST-PHARMACEUTICAL-SERVICES x2, GERRESHEIMER x2, STERIS, DANAHER, THERMO-FISHER-SCIENTIFIC, SIEGFRIED-HOLDING, BAXTER-INTERNATIONAL, BECTON-DICKINSON, HALOZYME-THERAPEUTICS) carry INFERRED evidence only (company blogs, product-launch and acquisition press releases, an IR press page) and are not admissible under the un-audited-mapping PLACEMENT rule. Bar two, profile availability: of the 14 mapped issuers, exactly 4 have a COMPLETE profile on disk (BECTON-DICKINSON, GERRESHEIMER, HALOZYME-THERAPEUTICS, WEST-PHARMACEUTICAL-SERVICES, all O2) and all four sit only on INFERRED-evidence placements. The 5 all-VERIFIED placements (CORNING, STEVANATO-GROUP, ATS-CORPORATION, DR-REDDYS-LABORATORIES, NOVO-NORDISK) have no profile on disk. Net effect: zero rows are seatable this run, on any of 13 links. This is a gate-driven finding, not an oversight or a gap in search: no row here weakens audit_scope PLACEMENT or accepts INFERRED evidence to force a seat.

autoinjector-and-pen-platforms [MONEY CORNER, UNDISCOVERED]: searched and empty, second time. Since the first run, data/mappings/glp1-fill-finish.json (commit d3ee61d) gained 4 fresh-context `placement_audits[]` entries on this exact link, all reviewed_by atlas-fresh-context: BECTON-DICKINSON PASS (live re-fetch of investors.bd.com confirmed the Vystra pen / semaglutide self-injection role); WEST-PHARMACEUTICAL-SERVICES FAIL (the cited westpharma.com blog names neither SmartDose nor SelfDose anywhere on the page); GERRESHEIMER FAIL (the cited gerresheimer.com page confirms Gx Inbeneo is 'the autoinjector' for 'home treatment' but not the claimed high-viscosity/subcutaneous/self-administration attributes); HALOZYME-THERAPEUTICS FAIL (the cited nasdaq.com press release could not be reached live and the nearest verifiable SEC-filed exhibit does not carry the cited phrase or figures). WEST, GERRESHEIMER and HALOZYME are excluded from this link on two independent grounds now: INFERRED-only evidence tier (unchanged from the first run) and a failed fresh-context role check confirming the specific claim as cited does not hold, so re-admitting them needs new sourcing, not just a re-audit. BECTON-DICKINSON is a different case: this run built the exact campaign-v1 row (issuer_id BECTON-DICKINSON, listing_id NYSE-BDX, link_id autoinjector-and-pen-platforms, audit_scope PLACEMENT, profile_ref data/companies/BECTON-DICKINSON.json, a COMPLETE O2 T1 profile) and ran tools/check_screen.py against it directly to test admission. It failed: check_screen.py's `_placement_admissible` (the function gating a PLACEMENT-scoped row over this un-audited mapping) reads only the placement's own `evidence` array on data/mappings/glp1-fill-finish.json and requires every item there tagged VERIFIED; it does not read `placement_audits[]` at all. BD's placements[] entry for this link still carries one evidence item tagged INFERRED, because Atlas's `--placement` audit contract writes only `audit`, `status`, `changelog` and `placement_audits` on the mapping (tools/check_map.py's allowed-fields list for that command), never the placement's own evidence tag. The exact failure: "audit_scope PLACEMENT on an un-audited mapping requires every evidence item on the placement to be VERIFIED; INFERRED issuer-role evidence needs the census audit." Per CLAUDE.md postlude 1f ("must pass; never commit around it"), the row is not written here. This is a real gap, not a data gap: CLAUDE.md's `run deepdive` row already accepts a current PASS `placement_audits[]` entry as an admission path for Stocky's gate (check_analyst.py), but check_screen.py has not been extended to accept the same basis for a screen row, so a PASS placement audit alone cannot open a screen row yet. Closing this needs either check_screen.py extended to recognise a current PASS placement_audits entry (tools/, outside this run's write scope) or the placement's own evidence tag upgraded to VERIFIED by Atlas (data/mappings/, outside this run's write scope); flagged as a background task rather than fixed here. Net effect on this link: still 0 of 4 placements seatable, but for BD specifically the blocker is now purely mechanical (a gate that has not caught up to a mechanism it already trusts elsewhere), not an evidentiary one.

None of the chain's own example_tickers for this link (BANB.SW, PPGN.SW, LONN.SW, 207940.KS, 2359.HK, TMO) appears in data/mappings/glp1-fill-finish.json; TMO is mapped only to sterile-fill-finish-capacity, a different link. This link needs a `run universe glp1-fill-finish` amendment before it can be screened at all, and it is the chain's one link with a dated lead-time figure (18 to 36 months for new reactor capacity), which makes the gap worth closing.

Zero mapped placements, by chain design: the chain's own note calls XOM/0386.HK/RELIANCE.NS "a trap: buying XOM is not buying GLP-1 capacity," and no listed pure play exists at this stage. Correctly un-mapped, not a gap.

us-onshoring-tariff-response [HIGH criticality, CROWDED]: searched and empty. Zero mapped placements, by chain design: example_tickers is deliberately empty (there is no instrument for a tariff schedule); the chain's own note routes the investable expression through the US-sited capacity at positions 4, 9 and 11 (primary-containment-converters, sterile-fill-finish-capacity, autoinjector-and-pen-platforms), each already covered above.

Net effect: 0 of 13 links produce rows this run (0 rows total). The money-corner link and all three CHOKE_POINT links are attributed as searched-and-empty with a stated reason, never silently absent. Three concrete next steps, none of them this run's to take: (a) `run profile <TICKER>` for GLW, STVN, ATS, RDY, NVO — five admissible, all-VERIFIED placements sitting unprofiled and blocking 5 of 13 links, unchanged since the first run (no profile for any of the five landed between runs); (b) either check_screen.py extended to admit a row on a current PASS `placement_audits[]` entry (as check_analyst.py already does for deepdive), or Atlas upgrading BECTON-DICKINSON's autoinjector-and-pen-platforms evidence tag to VERIFIED to reflect its PASS fresh-context audit — either would open the money corner on this one name; WEST-PHARMACEUTICAL-SERVICES, GERRESHEIMER and HALOZYME-THERAPEUTICS now need new sourcing, not a re-audit, since their fresh-context audits FAILED on the cited claim itself; (c) `run universe glp1-fill-finish` to close peptide-api-supply, which has zero mapped placements despite being a HIGH-criticality, dated-lead-time link. Not fixed here: data/mappings/, data/companies/, and tools/ are outside this run's write scope.

The two admissibility bars (evidence tier, profile availability) do not overlap on any of the 14 issuers this run, so 0 rows are seatable on any of the 13 links, including the single money-corner link (autoinjector-and-pen-platforms) and all 3 CHOKE_POINT links. Second run screen glp1-fill-finish (chain-level, scenario_id null), triggered by data/mappings/glp1-fill-finish.json (commit d3ee61d) gaining 4 fresh-context placement_audits[] entries on autoinjector-and-pen-platforms (the money corner): BECTON-DICKINSON PASS, WEST-PHARMACEUTICAL-SERVICES FAIL, GERRESHEIMER FAIL, HALOZYME-THERAPEUTICS FAIL. Per CLAUDE.md postlude 1f ('must pass; never commit around it'), did not force the row through; re-confirmed against the unmodified checked-in check_screen.py (this run's worktree is a detached checkout of origin/main). Net result: still 0 rows across all 13 links this run, but the money-corner link's single remaining candidate (BD) is now blocked purely by a gate that has not yet been extended to a mechanism (placement_audits) it already trusts for deepdive, not by an evidence gap; the other 3 placements on this link are now correctly excluded on two independent grounds.
